about: Named scopes for the ops-write catalogue-import runbook (scripts/ops/catalogue_import.py). A scope is what one run plans: coded Bandai JP series ids (series), uncoded product names exactly as Bandai's 入手情報 writes them (uncoded_products), or every product named inside uncoded catch-all series (uncoded_series) filtered by product_pattern / exclude_pattern (regular expressions) and exclude_products. Uncoded products are imported when they pass app.services.uncoded_product_evidence with the step C amendments (owner 2026-10-26): Asia-EN agreement per product, single-product catch-all, repeated codes with their own entries and image addresses; the rest are reported. report_only scopes never import. Adding or changing a scope is a reviewed PR.
